stops.note: Philosophy at the Barcelona seminary and Cervera; law degree Barcelona 1841.
Literature and history teacher at the Institut de Barcelona.
Chair of general and Spanish literary history from 1847.

people.name: Marcelino Menéndez Pelayo
people.bio: Spanish literary historian, student of Milà i Fontanals.

people.name: José Zorrilla
people.bio: Spanish Romantic poet and dramatist, author of Don Juan Tenorio.

stops.note: Law (years from the roster; not covered by the cited source).

people.name: Jean-Baptiste Say
people.bio: French economist, author of the Traité d'économie politique and of Say's law.

stops.note: Ran a cotton mill at Auchy after the Traité (1803) displeased Napoleon; dates approximate.
Political economy course at the Athénée.
Course in industrial economics.
Professor of political economy.
